models.name: Human Heart
models.description: A detailed 3D model of the human heart showing all four chambers, major arteries, and veins.

hotspots.label: Left Ventricle
hotspots.info: The left ventricle pumps oxygenated blood to the entire body through the aorta.

hotspots.label: Right Atrium
hotspots.info: The right atrium receives deoxygenated blood from the body through the vena cava.

hotspots.label: Aorta
hotspots.info: The aorta is the largest artery. It carries oxygenated blood to the rest of the body.

infoSections.title: Overview
infoSections.text: The human heart is a muscular organ about the size of a fist. It beats approximately 100,000 times per day.

infoSections.title: Chambers
infoSections.text: The heart has 4 chambers: Right Atrium, Right Ventricle, Left Atrium, and Left Ventricle.

infoSections.title: Blood Flow
infoSections.text: Body to Vena Cava to Right Atrium to Right Ventricle to Lungs to Left Atrium to Left Ventricle to Aorta to Body.
